FamilyTreeState.title: FamilyTreeState
FamilyTreeState.description: Stores real-time synchronized family tree additions, marriages, mothers, and photos

updatedBy.description: User or admin who made the update

ArchivalPhoto.title: ArchivalPhoto
ArchivalPhoto.description: Stores individual archival photo or historical document with metadata and image payload

id.description: Unique identifier of the archival photo or document

title.description: Title of the photo or document

url.description: Image URL or compressed data URL

category.description: Category such as documents, portraits, events, heritage, historical

VisitorCounter.title: VisitorCounter
VisitorCounter.description: Tracks total cloud visits to the family tree website

/family_tree/{docId}.description: Holds the shared real-time family tree data state

/archival_photos/{docId}.description: Holds individual archival photos and documents for instant cross-domain sync

/settings/{docId}.description: Holds site-wide settings and real-time visitor counter

/siteStats/{docId}.description: Holds real-time visitor counter under siteStats/visits

/site_stats/{docId}.description: Holds real-time site statistics and visit counter

/visitors/{docId}.description: Holds real-time visitor counter under visitors/count
